sentences.en: Unusually low temperatures account for the poor rice crop this year.
sentences.zh: 异常低温导致今年稻谷产量不佳。

sentences.en: Most Japanese eat rice at least once a day.
sentences.zh: 大多数日本人每天至少吃一顿米饭。

sentences.en: You must be hungry to eat so much rice.
sentences.zh: 你一定很饿，才吃了这么多米饭。

senses.zh: 用压粒机把（食物）压成米粒状
